days.title: Mattupetty Route
days.subtitle: Easy circuit with scenic spots and an early finish
days.description: An easy circuit with early finish - perfect for your first day. Visit Top Station, Echo Point and Mattupetty Dam.

priorityLocations.name: Tea tasting at a local estate

days.routePlan: Clockwise loop from Munnar → Top Station → Echo → Mattupetty → Carmelagiri → back to Munnar

locations.name: Leave hotel after breakfast
locations.description: Begin your day with a hearty meal as lunch options near Top Station are limited.
locations.travelTip: Pack snacks, water, and wear layers as temperatures can vary throughout the day.

locations.name: Early Wrap-up
locations.description: Head back to your accommodation to relax and prepare for an early start tomorrow morning.
locations.travelTip: Tomorrow requires a very early start (4:30 AM) for Kolukkumalai sunrise. Pack what you need tonight and get some rest.

summary.title: Day 1 Summary
points: Easy scenic drive with well-paved roads
No long walks or hikes - comfortable for all travelers
Approximately 6-7 hours total including all stops
Early wrap-up (4-5 PM) so you can rest for Day 2's early sunrise

days.title: Kolukkumalai & Western Munnar
days.subtitle: Stunning sunrise and western side exploration
days.description: Experience the unforgettable sunrise at Kolukkumalai followed by Gap Road, Lockhart gardens and more.

locations.name: Leave hotel for Kolukkumalai Sunrise
locations.description: The early wake-up is absolutely worth it for this spectacular experience.
locations.travelTip: Jeep required from Suryanelli (self-drive not possible). Pre-book jeep in advance (₹2000-₹2500). Wear warm layers - it gets cold at this altitude in the morning.
